newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Shandong Jan-Oct gold output up 13.46 pct.
newsitem.headline: China's Shandong Jan-Oct gold output up 13.46 pct.

text.p: Gold output in China's northern coastal province of Shandong in January to October rose to 38.1 tonnes, up 13.46 percent over the same period last year, the semi-official China News Service said on Thursday.
The output fulfilled 101.6 percent of the province's annual quota, the report said, without providing a source.
Profits for mines managed by provincial authorities reached 74.74 million yuan ($9 million) in the first 10 months of the year, the report said without giving details.
State-run Linglong Mining Co was China's first mine with an annual yield of over three tonnes, the report said.
